itinerary.title: Island Hopping 1 (SIC)

activities.text: OR Island Hopping Set Mabul (Add On RM250/Group)

activities: Check In Hotel at Semporna Town

itinerary.title: Semporna - Tawau
activities: Free & Easy OR can refer Additional Activities
Shared Airport Transfer to Tawau Airport (Airport transfer: 6am/7am/10am/12pm/2pm/5pm)

addons.title: Additional Activities

entries.name: Island Hopping (Full Day)
entries.includes: 1 x island trip (Set A/B/C), snorkelling equipment, shared boat transfer, 1 x basic lunch box, jetty fee, guide. Meeting point: Seafest Jetty

entries.name: Tawau Shopping Tour (Full Day)
entries.includes: Private transport, driver guide, airport transfer

entries.name: Timbun Mata Watersport (Half Day)
entries.includes: Parasailing, jet ski, transparent kayak, banana boat, paddle boat, UFO donut, hiking, snorkelling, buffet lunch. Meeting point: Timbun Mata. 2 sessions (choose 1): 8am - 1pm or 1.30pm - 5pm

entries.name: Seawalking
entries.includes: Meeting point: Seafest Jetty. Minimum 2 pax. Recommended to do on the first day

entries.name: Discovery Scuba Diving
entries.includes: Diving equipment, 2 x dives, dive master. Recommended to do on the first day

entries.name: Fun Dive
entries.includes: Diving equipment, 3 x dives, dive master. Recommended to do on the first day

entries.name: Honeymoon Room Deco
entries.includes: Room decoration (available in water chalets except Lato-Lato)

entries.name: Regular Size Cake
entries.includes: For birthday celebration or candlelight dinner

notes: All add-on activities must be confirmed and paid at least 2 days before the activity's day.
Add-on activity is subject to availability and weather conditions.

expect.title: Not Mentioned in the Itinerary
expect.body: Things not mentioned in the itinerary must be paid by customers, e.g. shower room, shopping etc.

expect.title: Prepare Cash
expect.body: Prepare cash if you plan to shop at Semporna Town Market. Cards and QR are not available at some shops and street stalls.

expect.title: Airport Transfer
expect.body: Sharing transport will be used for all activity transfers.

expect.title: Water Chalet
expect.body: 24 hours electricity with air conditioning (A/C), except Nusakuya which has only 12 hours A/C.

expect.title: Meals
expect.body: Meals provided during the trip (breakfast, lunch and dinner) will be local food.

expect.title: Island Hopping
expect.body: Sharing boat will be used for all island hopping activities.

expect.title: Triple Room Bed
expect.body: Triple sharing room with 3 single beds will be provided based on availability. An extra bed will be added if no triple bed is available in the travel period.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Price for single supplement is RM1,200 per person.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will be charged if the booking is made less than 45 days before departure.
All itinerary, flight, price or quotation is subject to change.
The itinerary during the trip is subject to change due to weather, traffic, safety and similar factors.
Final itinerary and accommodation arrangements will be shared 14 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting flights.
Any free activity is non-exchangeable for other activities, vouchers or cash if the client does not join, or due to availability and weather conditions.
Boat timing is subject to weather and sea tide conditions.
SIC = boat and activity sharing with other tourists.
Shared Airport Transfer = airport transfer sharing with other tourists.
Shared Boat Transfer = boat transfer sharing with other tourists.
Island hopping Set Mabul Island additional surcharge is only applicable for 1 Star & 2 Star Water Chalets.

deposit.text: prior to departure for full payment
